lod_evidence: SAM 3D Body mhr_head.py constructs MHR.from_files(..., lod=1) when the source MHR path is used.
The head's fixed keypoint_mapping width is 18439+127.
The loaded TorchScript has 18439 skinning rows and its face array exactly matches the official MHR LOD1 conversion mesh used by the MHR repository.
sam3d_mhr_runtime.lod_asset_limitation: The TorchScript object exposes no lod/version/model_version/mesh_lod attribute. LOD=1 is established by the wrapper source and exact topology match, not by self-describing metadata inside mhr_model.pt.

known_limitations: Canonical nearest-vertex distance measures geometric proximity, not anatomical or semantic correspondence.
The historical projection had no individualized SKEL fitting, no external occlusion model, no metric camera calibration and no target-point ground truth.
The earlier projection used the separate female E01..E20 atlas; it is evidence that the chain executed, not that the current male ENG_D01..ENG_D37 bridge is correct.

official_mhr_mapping_assets.directory: AI感知模块/研究资料/真实场景关键点定位_2026-09-06/local/MHR/tools/mhr_smpl_conversion/assets
official_mhr_mapping_assets.numeric_integrity: All four arrays have in-range source triangle ids and barycentric sums within 2.23e-16; tiny negative weights down to about -1.37e-13 are floating-point noise.
official_mhr_mapping_assets.key_finding: An official MHR<->SMPL mapping exists in addition to MHR<->SMPL-X. Because the reviewed SKEL skin explicitly shares the 6890-vertex SMPL topology, the direct SMPL mapping is a required comparison candidate.
official_mhr_mapping_assets.single_face_binding_issue: For all 37 reviewed points, the three source SMPL support vertices map through mhr2smpl_mapping.npz to three distinct MHR triangles. The official map therefore does not directly yield one MHR face_index plus one barycentric triplet for a DMD37 point. A project-defined surface projection or another correspondence rule is still required and must be audited.

issues: Topology contract says 'runtime default/full exported mesh' instead of the evidenced LOD 1 and omits the source commits/checkpoint hash.
Bridge audit says only MHR-to-SMPL-X is available, but the official repository contains four bidirectional SMPL/SMPL-X mapping assets.

The builder tests only project SKEL-to-SMPL-X nearest mapping followed by official MHR-to-SMPL-X. It does not compare the direct official MHR-to-SMPL path required by the available assets and the source's shared SMPL topology.
The 20 mm and 2 mm pass thresholds are not linked to a pre-frozen protocol or independent acceptance basis.
Replay=100% only proves that the newly selected MHR face/barycentric numbers reproduce themselves on the same rest mesh. It does not validate bridge choice.
Required canonical difference, surface/geodesic difference, side consistency, midline consistency, bilateral symmetry and anatomical-region sanity are not fully reported.

minimum_next_checks: Correct the topology contract to LOD=1 and bind it to the exact runtime asset, checkpoint, face hash and source commits.

Compare at least two explicit candidates on the same MHR LOD1 rest mesh: direct official MHR-to-SMPL lifting of the reviewed 6890-topology anchors, and the historical project SKEL-to-SMPL-X plus official MHR-to-SMPL-X chain.
For each candidate, record the pre-projection composed point, chosen MHR face/barycentric, Euclidean projection residual and pairwise canonical displacement.
Compute graph-geodesic distance on the exact MHR mesh if implemented reliably; otherwise mark it unavailable rather than substituting Euclidean distance.
Run explicit subject-left/right, midline, paired symmetry and coarse posterior-region sanity checks with declared axes.
Freeze acceptance thresholds before reviewing the comparison results. Until then, keep the atlas as a candidate and do not issue PASS_DMD37_MHR_ENGINEERING_ASSET.
